text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about that losin' streak<n>we've been on
lately...
choice_data_list: Sorry I haven't been much help...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What? No, no—you ain't got nothin' to<n>apologize for!

We're just gettin' started! I'm<n>gonna blast
through my competition<n>and finish first!
The two of us gotta work together,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What is it people say here in Japan?<n>Something
about workin' like ya got<n>three feet?
choice_data_list:
Let's take it step by step like it's a three-legged
race.
Let's work together like it's a three-legged race.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's it! Let's win this<n>three-legged race!

If we do our best side by side, I<n>betcha we can
make a lot of folks<n>happy!
Bring it on! Make it extra tough!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I just know everybody'll be happy<n>once I start
winning!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I'm bound to get mighty strong<n>with you
beside me, Trainer!
